sources.title: Z.ai GLM-4.7 release statement
sources.evidence: Z.ai-authored statement published December 27, 2025 explicitly says GLM-4.7 was released December 22. Identifies Z.ai and the GLM family, and links the public GLM-4.7 weights. Complete page accessed through web reader; direct Python request returned HTTP 403.

sources.title: GLM-4.7 exact checkpoint card
sources.evidence: Pinned card declares MIT, identifies GLM-4.7 and documents interleaved thinking, preserved thinking and per-turn control. It explicitly supports tool calls, thinking on/off and local deployment. Its citation is labeled as the GLM-4.5 report; that predecessor report is not silently used as GLM-4.7-specific counting evidence.

sources.title: Official model download table at pinned revision
sources.evidence: The exact GLM-4.7 BF16 row reports 355B-A32B, separately from GLM-4.7-FP8 and GLM-4.7-Flash. This is direct nominal total/active reporting for the assigned model. The row does not specify embedding, output-head or MTP accounting boundaries.

sources.title: GLM-4.7 exact checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Glm4MoeForCausalLM, 92 main layers with first 3 dense, 160 routed experts and top 8 per token, 1 shared expert, 1 next-token prediction layer, hidden size 5120, QK normalization, 96 attention heads/8 KV heads, untied embeddings and BF16. max_position_embeddings=202752. No visual or audio module is configured.

sources.title: GLM-4.7 native API documentation
sources.evidence: Complete Markdown page accessed at the .md URL. Exact GLM-4.7 section specifies text input/output, 200K context, 128K maximum output, thinking mode and function calling. Later sections about building camera applications do not state native image input.

sources.title: GLM-4.7 provider endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Direct JSON lists the Z.AI route with context_length=202752 and max_completion_tokens=131072. Novita advertises 204800, Google 200000 and Venice 198000; these are provider limits. Text-to-text modalities, reasoning and tools are documented. No inference call was performed.

sources.title: Public GLM-4.7 checkpoint metadata and chat template
sources.evidence: Public ungated repository at revision 602d01efcdd332c5238ca4bcede555defbe83eb7 contains safetensors weight files and a weight index. Card metadata declares MIT. Embedded chat template supports reasoning_content, enable_thinking, tool definitions/calls/responses and text content. No weight files downloaded or storage counts treated as exact learned parameters.

sources.title: GLM-5 technical report, later comparison checked
sources.evidence: Later report compares the exact GLM-4.7 on reasoning, coding and agents. Its architecture parameter table labels GLM-4.5 and GLM-5, not GLM-4.7; its explicit exclusion of word embeddings/output and inclusion of MTP therefore does not independently establish that boundary for GLM-4.7. GLM-4.7-Flash architecture experiments also concern a different variant.

sources.title: Later GLM-5 comparison card
sources.evidence: Checked the exact GLM-4.7 benchmark column. The 355B/32B scaling sentence names GLM-4.5, so it is not used as an additional GLM-4.7 count claim.

name.note: Exact full-size release, distinct from GLM-4.7-Flash and FP8 packaging.

developer.note: Original developer identifies this as its own GLM release.

family.note: Original release places GLM-4.7 in the GLM large language model family.

release_date.note: Explicit December 22 release in the developer statement dated December 27, 2025. Publication date and repository creation date are not substituted for release date.

open_weights.note: Developer links publicly downloadable, ungated checkpoint weights.

license.note: Exact checkpoint model-card license metadata is MIT. A separate LICENSE path returned 404; the verified declaration is the card, not a nonexistent file.

parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal model size from the exact GLM-4.7 download row. Not an exact checkpoint tensor total; the model-specific table does not define embedding/output/MTP inclusion, and no sibling accounting convention is asserted.

active_parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal active count from the exact GLM-4.7 355B-A32B row. No more precise phase or embedding/output/MTP boundary is claimed.

architecture.note: Exact configuration establishes a decoder-only causal MoE Transformer: 3 dense plus 89 MoE main layers, 160 routed experts/top 8 plus 1 shared expert, and a configured MTP layer. This is independent of the Flash variant.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint position capacity and Z.AI route agree at 202752; native docs round to 200K. Baseline 204800 matches the Novita route, not the native/checkpoint value. Output limit 131072 is separate.

modalities.note: Native text input/output. Descriptions of code that integrates cameras are application uses, not native image understanding.

reasoning.note: Supports thinking on/off, interleaved reasoning, preserved thinking across turns and per-turn control.

tool_call.note: Developer card, native docs and exact chat template establish structured function calls and tool responses.

description.value: Text MoE model for coding, reasoning and tool use, with interleaved and preserved thinking.
description.note: Replaces subjective mature/dependable language with supported architecture and capabilities.

Public GLM-4.7 checkpoint metadata and chat template

patch.notes: Z.ai lists GLM-4.7 as nominal 355B total and 32B active in its exact download row. These are not exact tensor counts; the table does not resolve embeddings, output-head or MTP inclusion, and the explicit GLM-4.5 counting convention is not transferred. The released checkpoint and Z.AI provider route specify 202752 tokens, rounded to 200K in native docs; Novita advertises 204800 for its route. The 131072 output limit is separate. Native modalities are text input and text output.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Adds MIT, directly reported nominal 355B total/32B active and exact-checkpoint MoE architecture. Corrects context from the third-party 204800 figure to native/checkpoint 202752. Confirms December 22, 2025 release, text modalities, reasoning and tools. Later primary comparisons do not justify importing a sibling parameter-count scope.
